sloka: एवं प्रविश्यैव नृपस्तदानीं श्वभ्रं महारत्नविभूषितं तत् ।सम्पादयामास तदा महात्मा शापं द्विजाभ्यां हि रुषा विमुक्तम् ।। ७.५४.१९ ।।
transliteration: evaṁ praviśyaiva nṛpastadānīṁ śvabhraṁ mahāratnavibhūṣitaṁ tat ।sampādayāmāsa tadā mahātmā śāpaṁ dvijābhyāṁ hi ruṣā vimuktam ।। 7.54.19 ।।

translations.english: Having thus just entered that well adorned with great jewels, the great-souled king then fulfilled the curse that had indeed been uttered with anger by the two Brahmins. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे चतुःपञ्चाशः सर्गः ।। 54 ।। Thus ends the fifty-fourth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
